title: Provably Efficient Representation Learning for Low-Rank CMDPs
abstract: arXiv:2611.07295v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study representation learning in low-rank Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs), where both value and reward functions are approximated by a set of unknown representation vectors, and the transition dynamics admit a low-rank factorization. The objective is to maximize expected cumulative rewards while complying with constraints on the expected cumulative utility. To achieve this, we propose \texttt{MFRLC} (Model-Free Representation Learning for Low-Rank CMDP), a model-free algorithm that uses a primal-dual scheme to effectively balance reward regret and constraint violations. translated_title: 低秩约束马尔可夫决策过程的可证明高效表示学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了低秩约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）中的表示学习问题，其中价值函数和奖励函数均由一组未知的表示向量来近似，且状态转移动力学具有低秩分解结构。目标是在满足期望累积效用约束的前提下，最大化期望累积奖励。为此，我们提出了MFRLC（面向低秩CMDP的无模型表示学习），这是一种无模型算法，采用原始-对偶机制来有效平衡奖励遗憾与约束违反。据我们所知，MFRLC是首个将最小二乘价值迭代与置信上界（LSVI-UCB）技术及原始-对偶方法相结合的低秩CMDP表示学习方法。MFRLC还通过函数近似的奖励项进一步增强价值函数估计，并学习从表示（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个结合LSVI-UCB与原始-对偶技术的无模型表示学习算法MFRLC，能够可证明地高效求解低秩约束马尔可夫决策过程，在有效平衡奖励遗憾与约束违反的同时学习未知表示。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MFRLC, the first model-free representation learning algorithm for low-rank CMDPs that combines LSVI-UCB with primal-dual techniques, provably balancing reward regret and constraint violations while learning unknown representations.
